source.name: Manthey – 'Manthey unveils a strong driver line-up for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship season'
source.note: Team title/major sponsor mapped to front placement, mirroring the MotoGP/WEC convention (wec league notes). Page undated; it announces the team's 2026 WEC season.
source.quote: Teaming up as The Bend Manthey, with The Bend – the world class Australian race track I co-founded – as our major sponsor

summary: 2026 FIA WEC LMGT3 entry (Porsche 911 GT3 R #92, run by Manthey). The Bend, the Shahin family's Tailem Bend circuit, is the major sponsor carried in the team name. Sponsor list not complete: the livery's manufacturer, tyre and technical-partner decals (Porsche, Goodyear, Motul and others) are not documented by a citable text source.
